summary: CDT Equity Inc. filed an 8-K/A (Amendment No. 1) on August 21, 2026, amending its February 24, 2026 Current Report regarding its initial investment in Sarborg Limited, a Cayman Islands company, with the earliest event date of February 19, 2026. The amendment supplies Item 2.01 disclosure plus Item 9.01(a) audited Sarborg financials for fiscal years 2025 and 2024 and Item 9.01(b) unaudited pro forma condensed consolidated financials. No price per share, stake percentage, premium, advisor, or close date is stated in this excerpt. Watch for the original Item 1.01/3.02 terms and any further amendments.
